purpose: Machine-readable interoperability profiles for optional tools that complement GTD without becoming host adapters or runtime dependencies.

companions.label: Plugin Autopilot
companions.integration: GTD defines the execution brief, work states, evidence, and completion contract; Autopilot may decide when and where agent work runs.
companions.evidence_contract: Autopilot execution logs are captured as execution history; GTD maintains the core workstream completion record.
companions.authority_boundary: Autopilot decides execution orchestration timing; GTD defines task readiness, state transitions, and completion evidence.

companions.label: Plugin Eval
companions.integration: GTD owns task execution and evidence capture; Plugin Eval may evaluate a skill or plugin artifact and feed findings back as verification evidence or follow-up work.
companions.evidence_contract: Plugin Eval results enter GTD as verification evidence artifacts; scores do not automatically override Done definitions.
companions.authority_boundary: Evaluation findings inform verification; GTD core criteria determine whether the work is genuinely complete.

companions.label: Superpowers
companions.integration: GTD can wrap a Superpowers-driven engineering workflow with explicit readiness, evidence, blocker, and done semantics without duplicating Superpowers skills.
companions.evidence_contract: Superpowers TDD and review outcomes populate GTD verification evidence tables directly.
companions.authority_boundary: Superpowers guides development disciplines; GTD wraps the high-level Execution Brief and readiness/done gates.

companions.label: ArmorCodex
companions.integration: Security findings can become GTD evidence, blockers, or follow-up tasks; GTD does not weaken or override the security tool's severity and validation semantics.
companions.evidence_contract: Security scan findings are recorded as blockers or follow-up tasks; severity scores are preserved without modification.
companions.authority_boundary: ArmorCodex owns security finding severity; GTD determines whether blockers prevent promotion through Ready/Done gates.

companions.label: Context7
companions.integration: Context7 may supply current library and framework documentation during research or implementation; GTD records relevant evidence and decisions but does not treat retrieved text as repository authority.
companions.evidence_contract: Retrieved documentation is cited in facts or decisions; external docs do not override repository architecture.
companions.authority_boundary: Context7 provides external reference context over MCP; repository source code and local governance remain primary authority.
